blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Bias has become a default lens for understanding what machine learning systems do and how we should relate to them. Bias is at root a deviation from a standard; in decision making systems we can supply a standard from outside: a law, a protected attribute, a benchmark, a statistical property. However, even there, biased is often used as a shorthand, without stating what the position taken is - a silent ``relative to''. In a general use of language models, nothing supplies the standard: there is no decision to audit and no counterfactual output, so the shorthand fails. We argue that positionality -- the located, articulated, owned and contestable position from which anything is said -- is the better grammar for the question these models now force: who is speaking, from where? Against the vendors' answer of nowhere and the seductive possibility of everywhere, we argue that when a model is taken as-if speaking, it speaks from somewhere, and this means positionality can describe models, and the way they are believed beyond their warrant, even though they are not accountable speakers. A model's positionality is laminar -- laid down across corpus, tuning, system prompt, application and the live conversation. We separate three sets of factors: the positionality of a model's creators, the behaviour they intend for it, and the behaviour it enacts, and situate current work within this matrix. This lets us highlight what each stratum inherits from the one below, with ruptures and collapses where that inheritance is disavowed. We then return to where models speak from, and discuss the implications for how models are made, read and held accountable.

blocks.en: 1. Introduction
blocks.zh: 一、导 言 导言

blocks.en: Bias is an effective framing for issues with decision making systems: the standard is supplied from outside — by law, a protected attribute, a benchmark, through principles of non-discrimination ( Gerards and Borgesius, 2022 ; Zuiderveen Borgesius, 2020 ) ; ( European Union, 2026 , Article 4a) . In AI systems more generally, biases range from this statistical representativeness ( Zhou et al., 2022 ; Buolamwini and Gebru, 2018 ; Selbst et al., 2019 ; Green and Viljoen, 2020 ; Raji et al., 2020 ; Barocas et al., 2019 ) through the production of gendered text and images ( Guilbeault et al., 2024 ; Bolukbasi et al., 2016 ; Zhao et al., 2018 ; Bianchi et al., 2023 ; Prates et al., 2020 ; Birhane et al., 2024 ; Qadri et al., 2023 ; Sheng et al., 2019 ) and into wider cultural productions ( Kommers et al., 2026 ; Cremaschi et al., 2025 ; Noble, 2018 ; Bunz, 2019 ; Daryani et al., 2025 ; Navneet et al., 2026 ; Jiang et al., 2023 ; Srinivasan and Uchino, 2021 ) . However, bias is often under-defined in the literature ( Ghosh and Wilson, 2025 ) , and it works as shorthand - there is always a silent ’… relative to ’. As commonly deployed, the term bias presupposes positionality , but does not clearly articulate it. In this paper, we contend that bias is the wrong grammar for what large language models (LLMs) do and how we relate to them. Instead, positionality fits better: it is a concept that already comes with practices of owning, articulating, costing and contesting a position, and avoids the presupposition of an unbiased position.
blocks.zh: Bias是决策系统问题的有效框架:标准由外部提供——通过法律、受保护的属性和基准,通过不歧视原则提供(Gerards and Borgesius,2022;Zuiderveen Borgesius,2020); (欧洲联盟,2026年,第4a条). 在更普遍的人工智能系统中,偏见的范围包括:这种统计代表性(周等人,2022年;Buolamwini和Gebru,2018年;Selbst等人,2019年;Green和Viljoen,2020年;Raji等人,2020年;Barocas等人,2019年),通过制作性别文字和图像(Guilbeault等人,2024年;Bolukbasi等人,2016年;赵等人,2018年;Bianchi等人,2023年;Prates等人,2020年;Birhane等人,2024年;Qadri等人,2023年;Sheng等人,2019年),以及进入更广泛的文化生产(Kommers等人,2026年;Cremaschi等人,2025年;Noval,2018年;Bunz,2019年;Daryani等人,2025年;Navinet等人,2026年;Jiang等人,2023年;和Uchino,2018)。 然而,偏见在文献(Ghosh and Wilson, 2025年)中往往定义不足, 其作用是简略的, 如通常采用的那样,偏差一词以立场为前提,但没有明确表述。 在本文中,我们主张,对于大语言模型(LLMs)的工作和我们如何与之联系来说,偏见是错的语法. 相反,地位更适合:这是一个已经涉及拥有、阐明、计算费用和质疑职位的做法的概念,并避免预先假定一个没有偏见的立场。

blocks.en: In language models, particularly when used for cultural production, there is no clear reference point to build bias relative to. Bias can be measured in limited situations: the insertion of pronouns into template documents ( Zhao et al., 2018 ) , roundtrip translations ( Prates et al., 2020 ) , choice of gender or style when generating images ( Bianchi et al., 2023 ; Guilbeault et al., 2024 ) , ideology ( Cremaschi et al., 2025 ; Buyl et al., 2024 ) – but even discussing ideology brings us into the realm where bias breaks down: there is no decision to audit, no counterfactual output , no protected attribute to test around. Further, part of cultural production is actually having a voice: the deviation from neutrality is precisely what is valued ( Kommers et al., 2026 ; Srinivasan and Uchino, 2021 ) . Without a clear standard to build bias relative to, what matters is the position taken in the assemblage of model, system and user.
blocks.zh: 在语言模型中,特别是在用于文化制作时,没有明确的参照点来建立相对于的偏差. bias可以在有限的情况下进行测量:在模板文件中插入代词(赵等人,2018年),圆通翻译(Prates等人,2020年),生成图像时的性别或风格选择(Bianchi等人,2023年;Guilbeault等人,2024年),意识形态. (Cremaschi等人,2025年;Buyl等人,2024年) — — 甚至讨论意识形态也让我们进入了偏见破裂的领域:没有审计决定,没有反事实输出,没有保护属性来测试周围. 此外,部分文化生产实际上有发言权:偏离中立性恰恰是受到重视的(Kommers等人,2026年;Srinivasan和Uchino,2021年)。 没有建立相对于偏倚的明确标准,重要的是模型,系统和用户组合中所采取的立场.

blocks.en: Language models are increasingly taken as if they are speaking – even if they lack the conditions of accountability to be a true speaker ( Gómez, 2026 ; Zhang, 2026 ) – and in this frame it makes sense to ask where the speech comes from . The default answer has been nowhere : the position of the vendors, that their models are even-handed, apolitical instruments with no positions of their own, except some bias that may be reduced ( OpenAI, 2025b ; Anthropic, 2025 ) , as an approximation of neutrality ( Fisher et al., 2025 ) . In contrast, Neuman ( Neuman, 2026 ) argues that language models offer the possibility of a view from everywhere , as they contain "representations of many social identities without personally inhabiting any one of them", giving a "moral standpoint unavailable to individual human reasoners". While there is something compelling to the idea that models are "condensates of human culture" ( Neuman, 2026 ) , and have a unique point to speak from, we argue it is important to treat it as somewhere . LLMs have a credibility excess ( Fricker, 2007 ; Bondy, 2010 ; Zhang, 2026 ) , where they are seen as more authoritative than warranted; this makes it relevant to ask what is the somewhere from which they speak, rather than falling back on the abstracted nowhere and everywhere .
blocks.zh: 语言模式越来越被看做是在说话 — — 即使他们缺乏成为真正演说家的问责条件(Gómez, 2026; Zhang, 2026) — — 在这个框架里,询问演说来自何处是有意义的. 默认的答案无从谈起:供应商的立场,即他们的模式是公平的,非政治工具,没有自己的地位,只是一些可能减少的偏见(OpenAI,2025b;Anthropic,2025),作为中立的近似(Fisher等人,2025年)。 与此相反,Neuman(Neuman,2026年)认为语言模型提供了从各地获得观点的可能性,因为语言模型包含了"许多社会身份的表述,而没有个人居住其中任何一个",给出了"个人理性主义者所无法具备的道德观点". 虽然模型是“人类文化的凝聚体”(Neuman, 2026), LLMs的可信度过剩(Fricker,2007年;Bondy,2010年;Zhang,2026年),他们被视为比正当权威更权威;因此,应该问一下他们说话的地方是什么,而不是回到抽象的地方和任何地方。

blocks.en: Positionality keeps the question "who is speaking, from where?" open, framing the shaping of a model as taking a position rather than removing a defect. Models take a particular, sedimented, composite position — laid down in a corpus, filtered by raters, written into a specification, steered by a deployer, bent by the conversation — that can be located, articulated, owned and contested, even without "a singular human social position." ( Neuman, 2026 ) . We explore what it means to take seriously the idea that a language model has a positionality, and ask what that is. Philosophically, this draws on a cosmopolitical worldview ( Stengers, 2005 ) , an avoidance of flattening towards a single consensus through keeping open multiple, divergent worlds. Alongside questions of the ideologies they encode ( Buyl et al., 2024 ; Cremaschi et al., 2025 ; Kröger and Barkett, 2025 ) , or the values they embody ( Birhane et al., 2021 ) , positionality offers a generative, diagnostic grammar to discuss multiple aspects of the operation of language models and their socio-technical embedding.
blocks.zh: 定位性使"谁在说话,从何而来"的问题保持开放,将模型塑造成一个位置而不是去除一个缺陷. 模型采取一个特定的,沉积的,复合的姿势——设置在一个体中,被测算器过滤,写成一个规格,由部署者指导,被对话弯曲——这种姿势可以被定位,表达,拥有和争论,即使没有"一个独特的人类社会地位". (Neuman, 2026) (英语). 我们探索认真对待一个语言模型具有定位性这个观念意味着什么,并询问这是什么. 从哲学上讲,这借鉴了宇宙政治世界观(Stengers,2005年),即避免通过保持开放的多个、不同的世界而走向单一的共识。 除了它们所编码的意识形态问题(Buyl等人,2024年;Cremaschi等人,2025年;Kröger和Barkett,2025年),或它们所体现的价值(Birhane等人,2021年)之外,定位还提供了一个基因诊断语法,用以讨论语言模型及其社会技术嵌入的操作的多个方面。

blocks.en: In the rest of the paper, we review core concepts of bias and positionality, and relate these to working with LLMs 2 before explicitly bridging key characteristics 2.4 to make the case that it is meaningful to talk about language models using the frame of positionality. The key contribution of the paper is a positionality matrix that i) builds an understanding of laminar positionality , as the model stack is constructed from choices of data through finetuning and presentation up to moments of interaction; and ii) articulates a separation between the positionality of creators, the positionality they intend for the artefacts to have, and the positionality the resulting systems actually take. We then discuss what this means for where LLMs speak from 4.1 and finish with some implications of taking up this perspective 4.2 .
blocks.zh: 在文件的其余部分,我们审查了偏见和地位性的核心概念,并将这些概念与LLMs 2工作联系起来,然后明确弥合关键特征2.4,说明使用地位性框架谈论语言模型是有意义的。 论文的主要贡献是定位矩阵,它一)通过微调和演示到互动的时刻,从数据的选择中构建模型堆栈,从而形成对叠层定位的理解;二)阐明创作者的位置特征、他们打算对手工艺品具有的位置特征以及由此产生的系统的实际位置特征之间的区别。 然后,我们讨论从4.1到4.1的LLMs发言的含义,最后讨论从这个角度考虑一些影响。

blocks.en: 2. Background
blocks.zh: 2. 背景情况

blocks.en: 2.1. Bias and language models
blocks.zh: 2.1. 偏见和语言模式

blocks.en: Bias is a word with plural histories, which is part of the problem with its casual usage sometimes "as a purely descriptive term, sometimes as a pejorative term" ( Danks and London, 2017 ) ; in statistical usage, it generally refers to difference between an estimator and a standard ( Danks and London, 2017 ; Reynolds and Suzuki, 2012 ) ; in electronics, it typically refers to setting the correct zero point for part of a circuit to operate around ( Horowitz and Hill, 2015 , Ch. 2) . Friedman and Nissenbaum imported the term to computer science for "systems that systematically and unfairly discriminate against certain individuals or groups of individuals in favor of others." ( Friedman and Nissenbaum, 1996 ) , looking at preexisting biases from society, technical biases in the construction of the system and emergent biases in its operation. Franke ( Franke, 2022 ) , drawing on Nozick ( Nozick, 1995 ) develops a typology of bias for decision making, covering uneven applications of standards versus biased selection of standards, and discrimination for purposeful bias against arbitrariness for unintended outcomes. Most recently, the term algorithmic bias is used to refer to "prejudicial, discriminatory, unjust, inaccurate, or otherwise disparate performance or outcomes from algorithmic systems based on racial, gender, or other attributes of an individual or a group" ( Birhane, 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: Bias是一个带有复数历史的词,它有时随随便便使用"作为一个纯粹的描述性术语,有时作为一个贬义词"(Danks and London, 2017),是一个问题的一部分;在统计用法中,它一般是指一个估计者和一个标准(Danks and London, 2017; Reynolds and Suzuki, 2012)的区别;在电子学中,它通常是指为一部分绕行的电路设定正确的零点(Horowitz and Hill, 2015, Ch.2). Friedman and Nissenbaum将该词导入到计算机科学中,用于"系统和不公平地歧视某些个人或群体而有利于他人的系统". (Friedman和Nissenbaum,1996年),研究了社会上原有的偏见、系统建设方面的技术偏见及其运作中出现的偏见。 Franke(Franke, 2022年)借鉴Nozick(Nozick, 1995年),为决策发展了一种偏见的类型,涵盖标准与有偏见的标准选择的不均匀适用,以及出于故意偏见而歧视对意外结果的任意性。 最近,算法偏差一词用来指"基于种族,性别,或个人或群体的其他属性的算法系统有偏见,歧视性,不公正,不准确,或以其他方式不同性能或结果"(Birhane, 2026).

blocks.en: These definitions are comparative of outcomes across different groups of people: rooted in unfair discrimination, uneven application of process or outcomes ( Gerards and Borgesius, 2022 ; Fabris et al., 2025 ; Zuiderveen Borgesius, 2020 ) . Behind the mathematics is the construction of what is ’good’: what the bias moves away from, what is optimised for - its analysis is "an inherently normative process" ( Blodgett et al., 2020 ) . When bias relates to fairness, Selbst et al. point at some of this hidden construction with the formalism trap , pointing out that "no definition might be a valid way of describing fairness", as what that means is contextual and politically contestable ( Selbst et al., 2019 ) ; it is an essentially contested construct ( Jacobs and Wallach, 2021 ) . This is not helped by narrow definitions of bias. Ghosh and Wilson ( Ghosh and Wilson, 2025 ) found that 82% of 189 papers on AI/LLM bias research did not establish a working definition of bias, defaulting to mathematical conceptualisations; aligned with this, they recognised that working with bias as a frame focused work on particular, identifiable biases (such as race and gender), typically interpreted though a relatively "Western" frame. When "‘bias’ simply refers to deviation from a standard" ( Danks and London, 2017 ) , even applied to moral standards, it still carries in the idea of the standard.
blocks.zh: 这些定义是对不同人群结果的比较:植根于不公平的歧视、过程或结果的不均匀应用(Gerards and Borgesius, 2022;Fabris等人, 2025;Zuiderveen Borgesius, 2020)。 数学背后是“好”的构建:偏差的转移、最理想的 — — 它的分析是“内在的规范性过程”(Blodgett等人,2020年)。 当偏见涉及公平时,Selbst等人用形式主义陷阱指向一些隐蔽的构造,指出"没有定义可能是描述公平的一种有效方式",因为这意味着上下文和政治争议(Selbst等人,2019年);这是一种本质上有争议的构造(Jacobs and Wallach,2021年). 狭义的偏见定义无助于做到这一点。 Ghosh和Wilson(Ghosh和Wilson,2025年)发现,189篇关于AI/LLM偏差研究的论文中有82%没有为偏差确立一个工作定义,而忽略了数学概念;与此一致的是,他们认识到,在偏差作用下,将特定、可识别偏差(如种族和性别)作为框架重点工作,通常通过相对“西方”框架来解释。 当“`偏见 ' 仅仅指偏离标准”(Danks and London, 2017)甚至适用于道德标准时,

blocks.en: This leads to alternative understanding of bias. Ghosh and Wilson go on to say that there is a less normative view of bias as "simply a slant without any valence", comparable to having an opinion that is "informed by their lived experiences and positionalities" ( Ghosh and Wilson, 2025 ) . Gupta et al. also discuss places where bias is helpful in making correct decisions ( Gupta et al., 2024 ) – indeed, ’setting the biases’ is part of moving a model away from producing even, white noise outputs; inductive bias may be the key determinant on natural intelligent systems ( Goyal and Bengio, 2022 ) . Lopez ( Lopez, 2021 ) develops a typology of bias in data-based algorithmic systems that specifically captures the broader social context in which bias plays out; this is brought strongly into the relational frame through a Foucauldian treatment of "mathematical tools as articulations of power relations" ( Lopez, 2023 ) .
blocks.zh: 这导致了对偏见的另一种理解。 Ghosh 和 Wilson 继续说,对偏见的规范性观点不如“简单的一个没有价值的斜面”,相当于拥有一种“从他们的经验和立场中知情”的观点(Ghosh和Wilson,2025年)。 古普塔等人著. 也讨论偏见有助于做出正确决定的地方(Gupta等人,2024年) — — 事实上, " 消除偏见 " 是将模型从偶发的白色噪音输出移走的一部分;诱导性偏见可能是自然智能系统的关键决定因素(Goyal和Bengio,2022年))。 Lopez (Lopez, 2021) 开发了基于数据的算法系统中的偏差类型,专门捕捉出偏差所表现的更广泛的社会背景;这通过富考尔德人对"作为权力关系表达的数学工具"的处理(Lopez, 2023)被强烈地带入关系框架.

blocks.en: However, bias is not the only frame. Power aware approaches to machine learning systems ( Barabas et al., 2020 , e.g.) ; ( Birhane et al., 2021 ) ; ( Kalluri, 2020 ) start from the idea that "the very understanding of bias and debiasing is inscribed with values, interests, and power relations that inform what counts as bias and what does not" ( Miceli et al., 2022 ) . When asking about removing bias, one must ask "“debiased” according to whom and for whom?" ( Miceli et al., 2022 ) . In a concrete example of real name policies, talking in terms of bias "tends to obscure a set of persistent questions behind and beyond the technical realms: What is a real name? Who decides over the realness of a name? And, do we need a real name policy at all?" ( Miceli et al., 2022 ) . This points to the key issue: there is no universal standard for what a real name is, so both fairness and bias are insufficient concepts: really, a system takes a position about what real names are, and we must engage with that position. In many situations, we can point at something that feels universal – "no one should be discriminated against" – but in addition to the difficulties of operationalising that idea, we can also notice that it is a particular position, and one that has not always been held. Dobbe et al. point to this around bias in decision making systems, with a call to recognise that our positionalities shape our epistemologies, which influences the way that we design with and around bias ( Dobbe et al., 2018 ) . While bias can form a useful boundary object for discussion of harms in algorithmic systems ( Grill et al., 2023 ) , particularly as it can be formalised and tested for, the question is, does a focus on bias mean other qualities are missed?
blocks.zh: 然而,偏见并不是唯一的框架。 权力意识的机器学习系统方法(Barabas等人,2020年,例如) ; (Birhane等人,2021年) ; (Kalluri,2020年) 以"对偏见和贬低的理解本身被刻在价值,利益,以及权力关系上,为什么是偏见和什么不是"(Miceli等人,2022年). 在问起是否消除偏见时,必须问“对谁和对谁来说是“偏见”? (Miceli等人,2022年). 在实名制政策的具体例子中, 何为真名. 谁决定一个名字的真实性? 而且,我们需要一个真实姓名政策吗?" (Miceli等人,2022年). 这说明一个关键问题:对于真名是什么,没有通用的标准,所以公平性和偏见都是不充分的概念:实际上,一个系统对真名是什么采取立场,我们必须参与这个立场. 在许多情况中,我们可以指点一些普适性的东西 — — “任何人都不应受到歧视” — — 但是,除了落实这一想法的困难之外,我们也可以注意到,这是一个特殊的立场,而且并非始终如此。 多布贝等人. 我们的立场决定了我们的认知, 影响着我们用和围绕偏见来设计的方式(Dobbe等人, 2018年)。 虽然偏差可以构成讨论算法系统中的危害的有用边界对象(Grill等人,2023年),特别是因为它可以被正规化和测试,但问题是,对偏差的关注是否意味着忽略了其他特性?

blocks.en: What we argue here is that bias does not give a full diagnosis of the idiosyncrasies of language models. There are many biases that can be found, pushed back against, repaired, but they only account for part of the interactional flow. Two related terms that work in a way that bias does not are ideologies ( Cremaschi et al., 2025 ) determining how models relate to political framings; and values, and their embedding in models and ML research ( Birhane et al., 2021 ) . In more general cultural production of language, "to categorize their outputs … presents a similar profile of problems as asking whether Anna Karenina is a superior novel to Jane Eyre, whether the spiritual life prescribed in Laozi’s Tao Te Ching is the right one" ( Kommers et al., 2026 ) . In short: there are a range of outcomes possible through engagement with LLMs, and as they work in the register of human communication, as epistemic technologies ( Alvarado, 2023 ) , bias is both too narrow and too implicitly defined to capture the key interactional issues.
blocks.zh: 我们在这里争论的是,偏见并不能充分诊断语言模型的特异性. 有许多偏差可以找到,推倒,修复,但它们只代表了互动流的一部分. 以不带偏见的方式发挥作用的两个相关术语是意识形态(Cremaschi等人,2025年),确定模型如何与政治框架相关;以及价值观,并将其嵌入模型和ML研究(Birhane等人,2021年)。 在较为普遍的语言文化制作中,"将他们的产出进行分类......呈现出类似问题的特点,如问安娜·卡列尼娜是否是比简·艾瑞(英语:Jane Eyre)更优秀的小说,老挝的陶特青(英语:Tao Te Ching)中所规定的精神生活是否正确"(Komers等人,2026年). 简言之:通过参与LLMS,可以取得一系列成果,由于它们在人类通讯登记册中发挥作用,作为认识技术(Alvarado, 2023年),偏见既过于狭隘,也过于含蓄地界定,无法抓住关键的相互作用问题。

blocks.en: 2.2. Positionality

Positionality as a concept has its roots in feminist epistemology ( Haraway, 1988 ) , and standpoint theory ( Stoetzler and Yuval-Davis, 2002 ; Hill Collins, 2000 ) , to capture the idea that knowledge and knowers are deeply intertwined, and marginalised knowers have had less credibility than they should. It pushes against an idea of dislocated, totalising knowledge – a weak objectivity ( Harding, 1991 ) – with the idea that the only way one can be objective is to include the position from which one sees ( Haraway, 1988 ) . Within the practice of research, this is often operationalised through the use of positionality statements , a genre of text that attempts to articulate the position a researcher takes relative to the subject, the participants and the research context ( Savin-Baden and Major, 2013 , p.81) ; primarily to help develop critical relations to the knowledge produced.
blocks.zh: 立场作为一个概念的根源在于女权主义认识论(Haraway,1988年)和立场论(Stoetzler和Yuval-Davis,2002年;Hill Collins,2000年),以抓住知识和知识者彼此深为交织的观点,而边缘知识者的信誉不如他们应该的. 它反对一种脱节、将知识完全化的观念 — — 一种软弱的客观性(Harding,1991年) — — 认为唯一能够客观的方法就是包括人们所看到的地位(Haraway,1988年)。 在研究实践中,这往往通过使用定位说明来操作。 这是一种文本流派,试图阐明研究者对研究对象、参与者和研究背景的立场(Savin-Baden and Major,2013年,第81页)。

blocks.en: In general, where standpoint theory has been used to explain why marginalised knowers have less credibility and power than they should, the question of "who is believed and why" ( Hill Collins, 2000 , pp. 252-256) , this essay runs the same machinery from the other end: it more about the credibility excesses ( Fricker, 2007 ) produced through language models, the weak objectivity ( Harding, 1991 ) of ’neutrality’, the Whiteness of AI ( Cave and Dihal, 2020 ; Katz, 2020 ) . By reframing these technologies as no longer having the possibility of an unbiased output, we seek to undermine the "god trick of seeing everything from nowhere" ( Haraway, 1988 , p. 581) and better situate interactions for critique, bringing in the compositions of models to "include systematic examination of [such] powerful background beliefs" ( Harding, 1991 , p.149) . In contrast to the idea of unbiased , Harding’s strong objectivity "requires that we investigate the relation between subject and object rather than deny the existence of, or seek unilateral control over, this relation." ( Harding, 1991 , p.152)
blocks.zh: 一般来说,在立场理论被用来解释为什么边际知识分子的可信度和权力比他们应该的要低的地方,即"相信谁和为什么"的问题(Hill Collins,2000年,第252-256页),这篇文章从另一端运行着相同的机器:更多的是通过语言模型产生的可信度过剩(Fricker,2007年),`中立性'的弱客观性(Harding,1991年),AI的白度(Cave and Dihal,2020年;Katz,2020年). 通过将这些技术重新描述为不再有可能实现无偏见的产出,我们试图破坏“从无到有地看到一切的神把戏”(Haraway,1988年,第581页),并更好地安排相互批评,使模型的构成“包括对[这种]强大的背景信仰的系统审查”(Harding,1991年,第149页)。 与不带偏见的想法相反,哈定的强烈客观性"要求我们调查主体与对象之间的关系,而不是否认这种关系的存在或寻求对这种关系的单方面控制". (Harding,1991年,第152页)

blocks.en: We are not claiming in any way that language models are people, or should be treated like people, or that Hill Collins’ ’lived experience as a criterion of meaning’ holds true for language models. Rather, the argument is that the terminology of positionality gives a more useful, and more nuanced, way to discuss the situated performance and inherited ontologies of LLMs. Human positionality is influenced by factors that are typically of concern in algorithmic bias such as gender and race, but positionality covers more than that: it accounts for beliefs, values and ideology, as well as relations within and beyond the current context of work that shape performance. Using positionality as a descriptor of what is behind model behaviour gives the model a stance , influence by the biases, assessments, embedded values, guardrails and other factors of production.
blocks.zh: 我们绝不声称语言模型是人,或者应该像人一样对待,或者希尔·柯林斯作为意义标准的长期经验对语言模型来说是真实的。 相反,这种论点是,定位术语提供了一种更有用、更细微的方式,可以讨论定位性能和所继承的有限责任公司本体学。 人的地位性受到诸如性别和种族等算法偏见中通常令人关切的因素的影响,但地位性涵盖的不止于此:它考虑到信仰,价值观和意识形态,以及影响业绩的当前工作背景内外的关系. 将定位作为模型行为背后的描述,使模型具有一种姿态、受到偏见、评估、嵌入值、护栏和其他生产要素的影响。

blocks.en: 2.3. Positionality and language models
blocks.zh: 2.3. 地位和语言模式

blocks.en: This is not the first work to look at how positionality and models come together. Cambo and Gergle ( Cambo and Gergle, 2022 ; Cambo, 2021 ) use the term ’model positionality’ to build a critical analysis of the decisions made when developing e.g. text classification systems, highlighting the relations between the model and its stakeholders. Through computational reflexivity and practices such as annotator fingerprinting they look at the position enacted by data driven models in relation to their various stakeholders, as well as developing practices for data scientists to relate to the model and its annotations. Santy et al. ( Santy et al., 2023 ) develop ’NLPositionality’ as a way to understand the positionality of datasets through re-annotation by diverse groups and similarity matching. Scheuerman, Woodruff and Brubaker ( Scheuerman and Brubaker, 2024 ; Scheuerman et al., 2025 ) do not talk about model positionality specifically, but do a lot of work to relate the positionality of developers to the artefacts created, showing that creator’s positionality is embedded in the outputs.
blocks.zh: 这不是研究定位和模型如何组合的第一个工作。 Cambo and Gergle(Cambo and Gergle, 2022年;Cambo, 2021年)使用 ' 模范位置性 ' 一词,在开发文本分类系统等时,对所作决定进行批判性分析,突出模型与其利益相关者之间的关系. 通过计算反射性和做法,如注释员的指纹,他们查看了数据驱动的模型相对于其各种利益攸关方所形成的位置,并制定了数据科学家与模型及其说明相关的做法。 桑提等编. (Santy等人,2023年)开发了 " NLPositionality " ,作为通过不同群体重新注释和相似性匹配来理解数据集位置的方法. Scheuerman, Woodruff and Brubaker (Scheuerman and Brubaker, 2024; Scheuerman等人, 2025年)并不具体谈论模型定位,而是做了大量的工作,将开发者的地位与创造的手工艺品联系起来,表明创作者的地位认同于产出中.

blocks.en: Against this background, several recent works draw this sense of positionality into conversation with the development of LLMs. Conti and Seele ( Conti and Seele, 2025 ) call for programmers to articulate their assumptions and political biases, so that an AI Positionality Statement can be crafted, which "communicates to end users the residual and inherited biases that may skew algorithmic outputs". This is a direct application of the disclosure mechanism from the social sciences to the production of AI artefacts. There is a focus here on bias, in particular those biases that the creators are able to reflexively produce about themselves or systematically derive from the system. Arzberger et al. ( Arzberger et al., 2026 ) also draw on Harding’s strong objectivity, and an increasing move towards reflexive practices in data annotation to develop reflexive annotation as the production of labels that include reflexive statements from the annotators about how their own positionality influences the choice of label. Reflexive annotation focuses on representing the positionalities of the annotators, but the broader project of develop situated alignment where "subjectivity, uncertainty, and social positioning are treated as epistemic resources rather than obstacles" is very much in line with the aims of the current paper. The computational hermeneutics argument from Kommers et al. ( Kommers et al., 2026 ) , that genAI systems are "recognised as cultural technologies" is also philosophically aligned, especially the idea that we need to work with situated cultural production rather that pure properties of model output. As part of developing the hermeneutic approach, they recognise pluralities, that "one person’s bias is another person’s values", especially as generative models "serve users with distinct values while being trained on materials whose authors often disagree" ( Kommers et al., 2026 ) . This goes along with recognising that ambiguity and uncertainty are often part of the creative expression with and around technologies and culture ( Gaver et al., 2003 ; Arzberger et al., 2024 ; Giaccardi et al., 2024 ) , and that meaning emerges in context – another argument against the "view from nowhere". Vogel & Quadflieg ( Vogel and Quadflieg, 2026 ) pick up this argument in the context of design, arguing that "AI systems function as engines of convergence, projecting a dominant view from a specific some -where while presenting it as a neutral standard for everywhere and everyone" - again, the god trick played out. In particular, they highlight the foreclosure of possibilities – a difficult concept to fit under the umbrella of bias, but a familiar issue to anyone who has worked in a group with someone overbearing and narrow minded. Casting AI systems as epistemic infrastructure , Patil et al. use the terminology of hauntology to talk in terms of designing with ghosts to capture the personalities left embedded in the models and their deployments that "haunt the present with the unfinished structures of colonial knowledge hierarchies" ( Patil et al., 2024 ) . Smith et al. are perhaps the closest in spirit to this current approach, arguing directly that "practices of positionality, source, and tool criticism … should continue to be carefully applied to … the systems that are used in digital methodologies" ( Smith et al., 2026 ) . Here they look at the idea of machine objectivity , that increased sense of objectivity engendered in people interacting with mechanical artefacts – whether photographs or decision models – while also noting that humans tend to interact with LLMs conversationally, as if they were human. There’s a duality here: the AI authority coming through in the as-if human setting, even if the resulting text can equally well be bullshit ( Hicks et al., 2024 ) . They complete the argument with the idea that one can use biased tools so long as one is aware of the biases and can take them into account, and that updating ones mental model in the right direction is a crucial part of this. Here, we believe that positionality is a broader tool for understanding than bias.
blocks.zh: 在这一背景下,最近几部作品将这种定位感吸收到与LLMs开发的对话中. Conti和Seele(Conti和Seele,2025年)呼吁程序员阐述他们的假设和政治偏见,从而可以制定AI定位声明,该声明"向最终用户传达可能扭曲算法输出的剩余和继承的偏见". 这是将社会科学的披露机制直接应用于人工智能工艺品的制作。 这里的重点是偏见,特别是创造者能够反射地自我反映或系统产生的偏见。 阿尔茨贝格等人. (Arzberger等人,2026年)也借鉴了哈定的强烈客观性,以及数据注释中越来越多的反射性做法,以发展反射性注解作为标签的制作,包括来自注解者的反射性声明,说明自己的地位如何影响标签的选择. 缩写注解注重于代表注释者的地位,但广义的开发项目定位一致,其中"主观性,不确定性,以及社会定位被作为感知性资源而不是障碍",与本文的目的非常一致. 考默斯等人的计算草本论论证. (Kommers等人,2026年),genAI系统"被承认为文化技术",这在哲学上也是一致的,特别是我们需要与定位的文化生产合作,而不是模型输出的纯性. 作为发展本体方法的一部分,他们承认复数性,即"一个人的偏见是另一个人的价值观",特别是作为基因模型,"在接受关于作者经常不同意的材料的培训的同时,保留具有不同价值的使用者"(Kommers等人,2026年). 与此同时,人们也认识到,模糊不清和不确定性往往是技术和文化及其周围的创造性表达方式的一部分(Gaver等人,2003年;Arzberger等人,2024年;Giaccardi等人,2024年),其含义出现在上下文中 — — 反对“观点从无到有”的另一个论点。 Vogel 和 Quadflieg 图像 (Vogel and Quadflieg, 2026)在设计的背景中挑出这一论点,认为"AI系统作为趋同的引擎发挥功能,从某个特定的地方投射一个主导观点——在那里把它作为所有地方和每个人的中立标准"——同样,神的诡计被玩弄. 他们特别强调了对各种可能性的取消 — — 很难在偏见的保护伞下适用,但对于那些在一个群体中工作的人来说却是一个熟悉的问题。 Patil等人将人工智能系统作为认知基础设施。 利用鬼怪学的术语在设计上与鬼魂交谈,以捕捉模型中留下的人物及其部署,这些模型及其部署"以殖民知识等级的未完成结构来嘲讽现在"(Patil等人,2024年). 史密斯等人在精神上也许最接近于这个目前的方法,直接认为"立场,来源,和工具批评的实践...... 应当继续谨慎地适用于. 用于数字方法的系统”(Smith等人,2026年)。 在这里,他们审视了机器客观性的理念,即人们在与机械手工艺品互动时产生的更高的客观性感 — — 无论是照片还是决策模型 — — 同时也注意到,人类倾向于与LLMs对话,好像他们是人类。 这里有一个双重性:人工智能权威在人类的环境下通过,即使由此产生的文本同样可能是废话(Hicks等人,2024年)。 他们用这样的观点来完成争论,即只要人们意识到这些偏见并能够考虑到这些偏见,就可以使用有偏见的工具,而向正确方向更新这些心理模型是这方面的一个关键部分。 在这方面,我们认为,地位是理解而不是偏见的更广泛工具。

blocks.en: 2.4. From artefacts with politics to models with positionalities
blocks.zh: 2.4. 从带有政治色彩的手工艺品到具有地位的模式

blocks.en: Designed artefacts carry some of the positions of their makers and their political arrangements – Winner’s posed question about the politics of artefacts being a prime articulation ( Winner, 1999 ) , but also preexisting bias ( Friedman and Nissenbaum, 1996 ) . We are used to the idea that production is situated, and the resulting socio-material ecologies embody that ( Suchman, 2002 ) , and that interfaces encode positionality ( Murray-Rust and Giaccardi, 2026 ) . This is perhaps most succinctly summed up in Hill Collins’ quoted story: "“Mama, something’s wrong with that statue. Everybody knows that a man can’t whip a lion.” “But darling,” her mother replied, “you must remember that the man made the statue.”".
blocks.zh: 设计出来的工艺品带有其制造者的一些立场和政治安排 — — 赢家质疑手工艺品的政治是首要的表述(Winner,1999年),但也存在先前存在的偏见(Friedman和Nissenbaum,1996年)。 我们习惯于认为生产是存在的,由此产生的社会-物质生态学就体现了这一点(Suchman,2002年),以及编码定位(Murray-Rust和Giaccardi,2026年)。 这或许在希尔·柯林斯(Hill Collins)所引用的故事中最简洁地总结道:"妈妈,那雕像有些不对劲. 每个人都知道,一个人不能鞭打狮子。 她的母亲回答说,“你必须记得,雕像是那个人造的。”

blocks.en: There’s a change in this sense of the politics of objects, perhaps best located in the mid 2010s, theorised to around the rise of smartphones and more generally the introduction of ’smart’ devices into everyday life, with the recognition that objects are better seen as fluid assemblages ( Redström and Wiltse, 2018 ) . This brings a recognition that the identities of objects and the meanings associated with them are co-constructed, as activities are co-performed ( Kuijer and Giaccardi, 2018 ) , through our entangled relations to technology ( Giaccardi and Redström, 2020 ; Frauenberger, 2020 ) . Simultaneously, the scope of model output has changed dramatically with LLMs: beyond constrained tasks of classification, modern LLMs interact conversationally in a fluid manner; create plan-like objects and create descriptions of reasoning; coordinate with others; solve mathematical problems; cause humans to develop affective attachments and so on ( Gómez, 2026 ) . In common usage, many of the interactions are treated as-if the model is speaking: the text produced is read dialogically, treated as an utterance, responded to in the ways that humans do to other kinds of speech. Despite lacking an integrated being-in-the-world ( Bunz, 2024 ) , and leaning heavily on the human context around them for repair and structure ( Pütz and Esposito, 2024 ) , "they present linguistically articulated responses within an interactive exchange, often in ways that invite trust, justification, and further inquiry" ( Gómez, 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 更一般地说, 将智能设备引入日常生活, 这使人们认识到,物体的特性及其相关意义是共同构建的,因为活动是通过我们与技术的缠绕关系(Giaccardi和Redström,2020年;Frauenberger,2020年)共同完成的。 同时,模型输出范围也随着LLMS发生了巨大变化:超越了受约束的分类任务,现代LLMS以流畅的方式进行对话互动;创建类似计划的对象并创建推理描述;与其他人协调;解决数学问题;使人类发展情感附属物等(Gómez, 2026). 在通常的用法中,许多相互作用被当做——如果模型正在说话的话: 生成的文本是用对话方式读的,被当做一种言语,用人类对其他种类的言语所做的方式回应. 尽管缺乏一个融合的世界(Bunz, 2024年), 并且大量依赖周围的人文环境进行修复和结构(Pütz and Esposito, 2024年), “他们在互动交流中,

blocks.en: This situation, of interacting as-if , whether in the mould of Coeckelburgh’s ’social fellows’ ( Coeckelbergh, 2011 ) , or Bomba’s ’smark’ attitude ( Bomba, 2025 ) of knowing going along with , yet with no clear legal, moral or intentional grounding for statements leads to an "epistemic responsibility gap" ( Gómez, 2026 ) . It is a situation of "assertion without asserter", as models cannot be held to account for their productions ( Gómez, 2026 ; Zhang, 2026 ) . However, understanding of the phenomenology and relationality that arises through interaction is necessary to explain why users react the way they do, and specifically "even if LLMs do not qualify as speakers, their outputs may nonetheless function as assertions in a practically and normatively relevant sense" ( Gómez, 2026 ) , with accountability located in the assemblage rather than an author ( Uebel and Hamamra, 2026 ; Widder and Nafus, 2023 ) .
blocks.zh: 无论是在Coeckelburgh的社会研究员(Coeckelbergh,2011年)的模式中,还是在孟买的马克(Bomba,2025年)的态度中, 由于模型不能对其制作负责(Gómez, 2026;Zhang, 2026), 然而,理解通过互动产生的现象学和关系性对于解释用户的反应方式是必要的,具体来说,“即使LLMs没有资格作为演讲者,其产出仍然可能在实际上和规范上相关意义上作为断言发挥作用”(Gómez, 2026年),责任在于集合而非作者(Uebel and Hammra, 2026年;Widder and Nafus, 2023年).

blocks.en: Concurrently, positionality is becoming a first-class object in designing with language models. With synthetic personalities, position is used to provides an opinionated view of the underlying data, detailing the stance that should be taken ( Schmidt et al., 2024 ) . In speculative work, positionality is used to provoke extreme responses - what if the model was mycelium, or fireflies, or an aquifer ( Giaccardi et al., 2026 ) ? In these cases, the boundaries between deliberate positioning and emergent behavior blur, the co-performance ( Kuijer and Giaccardi, 2018 ) of dialogue making it difficult to trace whether the position arises from the model’s construction, the user’s prompts, or the interactional feedback loop unfolding in real time ( Murray-Rust and Giaccardi, 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 同时,位置性正逐渐成为与语言模型一起设计的一流对象. 在合成人格方面,立场被用来提供对基础数据的看法,详细说明应采取的立场(Smidt等人,2024年)。 在投机工作中,位置性被用来引起极端的反应——如果模型是菌丝、萤火虫或含水层,怎么办(Giaccardi等人,2026年)? 在这些案例中,有意定位和突发行为之间的界限模糊不清,对话的共同性能(Kuijer和Giaccardi,2018年)使得难以追踪该位置是来自模型构建,用户的提示,还是实时展开的互动反馈循环(Murray-Rust和Giaccardi,2026年).

blocks.en: At this point, it makes sense to ask: for a positional treatment of the particularity of LLMs, which aspects of positionality hold true for models, with all their abstract lack of life-course. Drawing on sources from Section 2.2 , we develop six characteristics to investigate. The first four of these are characteristics of understanding what positionality is, and where it works from:
blocks.zh: 此时,要求:对LLMS的特殊性进行定位处理是有道理的,而LLMs对于模型来说,位置性的某些方面是真实的,而其抽象的缺乏生命过程. 根据2.2节的资料来源,我们开发了6个特征进行调查。 其中前四种特征是理解什么是位置性,从何而来:

blocks.en: • Locative : Positionality is a where - a location from which one sees and speaks, and "the only way to find a larger vision is to be somewhere in particular" ( Haraway, 1988 , p. 590) , or "You have to position yourself somewhere in order to say anything at all" ( Bourke, 2014 ) . For models, is not necessarily a physical position; within the metaphor of vision, it is as much a perspective, a point of view. There is also the more direct answer: models speak from data centres, from laptops and edge devices, from Silicon Valley. The need for multiple locations here implies that we need to understand positionality in a plural manner. • Constitutive : If there is "no enunciation without positionality" ( Bourke, 2014 , quoting Hall 1990) – every utterance comes from a speaker, as the condition of saying anything. Models are read as-if speaking ( Gómez, 2026 ; Zhang, 2026 ) , and as such have a constitutive relation to their production – and even when models pretend a "neutral" register, this is in itself a position. Models act as proxy partners in their performance, sussuming the positionality of the whole socio-technical constellation, including their datasets, developers and computer scientists, company guidelines and internal representations. Even if models do not have intentionality, they influence users through perlocutionary agency ( Bomba and De Angeli, 2025 ) . • Relational : Positionality, as used in positionality statements, is a relative quality: "that a researcher has chosen to adopt within a given study" ( Savin-Baden and Major, 2013 , p.71) , relative to i) the subject; ii) the participants and iii) the context and process of the work ( Darwin Holmes, 2020 ) . Models are processed towards particular kinds of utterance in their development, some more and some less explicit. blocks.en: The final two are the results and implications of being clear about positionality - the hoped for effects of highlighting this approach to knowledge:
blocks.zh: 最后两项是明确立场的结果和影响——希望强调这种知识方法的效果:

blocks.en: • Articulated and owned : The principle of positionality statements is that "the knower’s own position must be brought into the field of inquiry" ( Harding, 1991 ) , so that we become "answerable for what we learn how to see" ( Haraway, 1988 , p.583) , in line with Suchman’s located accountabilities ( Suchman, 2002 ) , and against the idea of "knowledge claims without owning their position" ( Hill Collins, 2000 , p.270) . Currently, the positionality of most models is obscure, both intentionally, through a pretence of objectivity, and through a lack of clear disclosure efforts with the exception that some models reference the position of particular groups, or political approaches to data, training or other factors – see Section 3.2 . • Costly and contestable : Owning a position leaves one open to challenge; rather than giving a license say certain things, it gives a frame for exploring validity - partial, locatable, critical knowledges are the ones that can be held to account ( Haraway, 1988 ) . The lack of positional information about models undermines the ability to contest them: without commitment, there is no cost - "answerability-void argumentation" of "outputs that function socially as reasons within our argumentative practices while being produced by systems that lack the agential standing required to be proper bearers of epistemic and moral responsibility" ( Zhang, 2026 ) . Dealing with this gap is part of what we might want from a better articulation of model positionality.

blocks.en: This leads to a strange situation, where LLMs fail key aspects of having a position: they have only read, they are mouthing the words without lived experience, they lack the illocutionary force to perform true speech acts ( Bomba and De Angeli, 2025 ) . However, they are believed anyway, and despite a lack of intention, they influence interactions through their perlocutionary action ( Bomba and De Angeli, 2025 ) , and are often taken as more credible than they should be. This excess of credibility is produced by factors such as i) machine objectivity ( Smith et al., 2026 ) ; ii) the ’conversational as-if ’ ( Gómez, 2026 ; Zhang, 2026 ) ; the social weight of the corporate vendors; and the Whiteness of the apparatus around it ( Cave and Dihal, 2020 ; Katz, 2020 ) . We introduce positionality to highlight the gap between accountability and the as-if of conversation: by better naming the positions taken, it becomes possible to better critique production, interaction and their effects.

blocks.en: 3. Laminar Stack: Inheritance and Rupture
blocks.zh: 3个 Laminar Stack:继承与修饰

blocks.en:
Language models are not human; they have no life course on which to draw to construct their standpoint. Rather, they are technical constructions, that draw on chunks of human culture through a gradual layering of data, computation and relations.
Multiple layers of positionality intertwine within a language model: from corpus through to the final application interface, create a shifting, composite positionality enacted through dialogue and read within interactions. In this laminar positionality, "layers do not simply stack but flow" ( Murray-Rust and Giaccardi, 2026 ) , sedimenting and trying to mange the troublesome inheritances of the last. Each layer carries its own positional relations, as well as the positional relations of those involved in creating it. We trace the stack here to highlight questions of positionality and bias at each layer, along with the work that constructs them - much in the mould of Haraway "showing the radical historical specificity, and so contestability, of every layer of the onion of scientific and technological constructions" ( Haraway, 1988 ) . There are precedents to making use of this stack model for discussing data driven technologies: sources of harm by model development stage ( Suresh and Guttag, 2021 ) ; accountability practices along the dataset lifecycle ( Hutchinson et al., 2021 ) ; end-to-end internal audits ( Raji et al., 2020 ) ; per-stage reporting for RL systems ( Gilbert et al., 2023 ) ; distributed accountability within the AI supply chain ( Widder and Nafus, 2023 ) ; and clear engagements with positionality at particular stages of development ( Miceli et al., 2021 ; Scheuerman et al., 2025 ; Scheuerman and Brubaker, 2024 ) .
blocks.zh:
语言模型不是人类的;它们没有生命的路线可以用来构建其观点。 相反,它们是技术构思,通过数据、计算和关系的逐步分层利用了人类文化。
语言模型中的多层位置间争:从实体到最终应用界面,通过对话形成一个变化的复合位置性,并在互动中读取. 在这种懒惰的姿势中,"层层不只是堆叠,而是流动"(Murray-Rust和Giaccardi,2026年),沉积并试图修补上层的麻烦遗产. 每层都承载着自己的立场关系,以及参与创建者的立场关系. 我们追踪这堆东西,以强调每一层的位置性和偏差问题,以及构建它们的工作,这些工作在哈拉威的模版中大多是"展现出科技建筑每一层洋葱的激进历史特异性,因而具有竞争性"(Haraway,1988年). 在讨论数据驱动技术方面,有先例可循:模型开发阶段的危害源(Suresh和Guttag, 2021年);数据集生命周期的问责做法(Hutchinson等人, 2021年);端到端内部审计(Raji等人, 2020年);RL系统的每阶段报告(Gilbert等人, 2023年);在AI供应链中分配问责(Widder和Nafus, 2023年);在特定开发阶段具有明确的定位(Miceli等人, 2021年;Scheuerman等人, 2025年;Scheuerman和Brubaker, 2024年)。

blocks.en: We build our idea of model positionality on the idea that there are many factors that give rise to model behaviour, including biases and training corpora, but also including the positionality of their creators, and ways in which the models are put into the world. As such, we consider three different sets of factors: i) the positionality of the creators , and its articulation through reflexivity practices ; ii) the intended behaviour or positionality and statements of it; and iii) the enacted behaviour, from which positionality may be read, inferred or audited, and which often includes non-intentional behaviours 1 . Each of these factors can be summarised in Table 1 , to give an overview of the core layers. The first two sets of factors are causal: the people creating the model or interaction, and their intentions in doing so give rise to the positionality of the model artefacts, at a variety of timescales and fixities: corpora move slowly, tuning less so, and system prompts can change responsively. These positionalities are layered through the creation process to give a point from which the model can be seen as speaking that is relatively stable, barring collapses ( Murray-Rust and Giaccardi, 2026 ) and ruptures that we discuss in Section 3.7 . The enacted behaviour or outcome is then a site from which positionality may be read or inferred, through understanding the import of statements, tone of voice, presentation and other factors.
blocks.zh: 我们把模型定位的概念建立在这样的思想之上:有许多因素引起模型行为,包括偏见和培训公司,但也包括其创造者的地位,以及模型被引入世界的方式. 因此,我们考虑了三组不同的因素:(一) 创造者的地位及其通过反射性做法的阐述;(二) 其意图行为或地位和声明;(三) 颁布的行为,从中可以读取、推断或审计其地位,而且往往包括非故意行为。 1 (英语). 这些因素都可以在表1中概述,以概述核心层。 前两组因素是因果因素: 创建模型或相互作用的人,他们这样做的意图是产生模型手工艺品的位置,在各种时间尺度和固定性上: corpora移动缓慢,调谐较少,系统提示可以响应变化. 这些位置通过创建过程分层,以给出一个点,从中可以将模型视为相对稳定的语句,阻止崩溃(Murray-Rust和Giaccardi, 2026年)以及我们在3.7节中讨论的破裂. 然后,颁布的行为或结果就是一个场所,通过了解发言的输入、语音的语气、表述和其他因素,可以读取或推断其位置。

blocks.en: 3.1. Ground

The world of texts is large and as diverse as humanity. Texts are polyvocal, heteroglossic ( Bakhtin, 1988 ) ; authors take multiple positions and registers; it contains hate speech; true enactments, fictions, fabulations all woven together; lies; formalised information; minority languages; majority languages; dialect; multiple time periods; poetry etc. etc. Textual material in common corpora encode all the positionalities performed by their human producers and their characters; the corpus inherits these enacted positions, not necessarily the authors positions or their intentions ( Bunz, 2019 ) . To the existing fabrications, we can add the new category of texts specifically designed to provoke behaviour in language models, such as the hot-dog eating journalist ( Germain, 2026 ) , and language models starting blogs to influence humans ( Rathbun, 2026 ) . There are not statements to make across this level, other than to point out the impossibility of characterising the total of all texts that might be used. Positional legibility is a challenge ( Munir et al., 2026 ) , and one of the few possible statements of intent available to authors is to opt out ( Longpre et al., 2024 ) or engage in copyright action ( Lee et al., 2023 ) .
blocks.zh: 文本的世界很大,与人类一样多样。 文本是多语种的、异质的(Bakhtin,1988年);作者采取多种立场和登记;其中包含仇恨言论;真正的立法、虚构、浮夸所有编织在一起;谎言;正式化的信息;少数民族语言;多数语言;方言;多个时期;诗歌等。 页:1 共同公司中的文字材料编码了其人类生产者及其人物所执行的所有位置;本书继承了这些既定位置,并不一定是作者的职位或意图(Bunz, 2019). 在现有的编造中,我们可以加上专门用来激起语言模型行为的新类文本,如热狗吃记者(Germain,2026年),以及开始博客影响人类的语言模型(Rathbun,2026年). 除了指出无法说明可能使用的所有案文的总数之外,在这一级别上没有其他说明。 位置可辨性是一个挑战(Munir等人,2026年),作者所能获取的少数可能的意向声明之一是选择退出(Longpre等人,2024年)或参与版权诉讼(Lee等人,2023年).

blocks.en: 3.2. Corpus

The corpus of a language model is a strong determinant of its operation. It is not always clear how that comes about, or what the specific effects of a specific corpus will be. Textual material in common corpora have many positionalities, selected from the ground of the layer below. The creator ’s attitudes and positionality affects the way that they approach collecting the corpus, this is sometimes framed as data provenance and labour ( Baack, 2024 ; Crawford and Paglen, 2019 ) . Their relation to framing issues of copyright and legal exposure also shape the set of text that can be brought in, whether the approach of Common Corpus to only use uncopyrighted or permissively licensed material ( Langlais et al., 2026 ) , or the destructive scanning used in Anthropic’s Project Panama ( Schaffer et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 语言模型的集合是其运作的一个强有力的决定因素。 情况并非总是很清楚,具体文书的具体效果如何。 共同体中的文字材料有许多位置,从下面的地层中选取. 创作者的态度和姿势会影响他们对待收集本体的方式,有时这被设定为数据来源和劳动(Baack, 2024; Crawford and Paglen, 2019). 它们与设定版权和法律曝光问题的关系也决定了可以带入的一套案文,无论是共同公司只使用未经复制或许可许可的材料(Langlais等人,2026年),还是Anthropic的巴拿马项目(Schaffer等人,2026年)中使用的破坏性扫描。

blocks.en: The Intended behaviour can take several forms: Common Crawl gave a shared base for much language model work, being a ’representative selection of the internet’, even if not intended for that purpose ( Baack, 2024 ) , just as ImageNet shaped vision models ( Crawford and Paglen, 2019 ; Lyons, 2020 ) . The question of which URLs to include, the languages used, the frequency of updates all shape the set of data that is finally used in creating the foundations of language models: does it include hate speech, pornography, political rhetoric? As well as ’default’ collections, purposeful viewpoints can be chosen: Te Hiku Media’s Māori language models under the Kaitiakitanga Licence — the corpus governed as taonga by the community whose language it is ( Jones et al., 2023b ) (see also ( Pinhanez et al., 2024 ) for the wider indigenous-language case); within Western traditions, the training data for GPT-NL or euro-llm are specifically framed for a European viewpoint ( Martins et al., 2025 ) . Here, the intended positionality is often conveyed by statements like datasheets ( Gebru et al., 2018 ) that detail the decisions and processes behind the corpus.
blocks.zh: 意图行为可以采取几种形式: 通常的Crawl为许多语言模型工作提供了共享的基础, 成为互联网的代表选择, 究竟要包含哪些URL,所使用的语言,更新的频率都塑造了最终用于创建语言模型基础的数据集:它是否包括仇恨言论,色情,政治言论? 除了 " 默认 " 的集合之外,还可以选择有目的的观点: Te Hiku Media在Kaitiakitanga许可证下的毛利语模式 -- -- 由语言所在的社区(Jones等人,2023年b)作为taonga管理(另见(Pinhanez等人,2024年)) -- -- 在西方传统中,GPT-NL或欧元语言的培训数据是专门针对欧洲观点的(Martins等人,2025年)。 在此,意向性往往通过诸如数据表(Gebru等人,2018年)等描述来表达,这些陈述详细介绍了本书背后的决定和程序.

blocks.en: The enacted behaviour can differ from the intended ones. The C4 corpus aimed to filter out harmful context, but the enacted effect was to strip African-American English and LGBTQ text ( Dodge et al., 2021 ) , exemplifying the gap between intended and enacted positionality. The corpus is also shaped by factors such as political content – which translated to behaviour later on ( Ceron et al., 2025 ) ; dated knowledge ( Cheng et al., 2024 ) ; linguistic dominance ( Navneet et al., 2026 ) and so on. These gaps between stated or intended corpora can be read by base-checkpoint audits ( Ceron et al., 2025 ; Buyl et al., 2024 ) , although vendors seldom report at this level.
blocks.zh: 颁布的行为可能不同于预期的行为。 C4官制旨在过滤有害背景,但颁布的效果是剥离非裔美国人的英语和LGBTQ文本(Dodge等人,2021年),说明意图和颁布位置之间的差距. 政治内容(Ceron等人,2025年),日期知识(Cheng等人,2024年),语言主导(Navanet等人,2026年)等因素也决定了本书的内容。 虽然供应商很少在这个级别上报告,但通过基准检查点审计可以了解已申报或打算申报的公司之间的这些差距(Ceron等人,2025年;Buyl等人,2024年)。

blocks.en: 3.3. Training and Finetuning
blocks.zh: 3.3. 培训和微调

blocks.en: Language models are not put into the world purely based on unstructured learning over a large corpus. There is a process of shaping the model towards certain ways of responding. This often works through a combination of training with exemplar prompt response pairs, fine-tuning, and reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF) ( Chaudhari et al., 2025 ; Coyne, 2026 ) . Here, there is an explicit move towards a normative interpretation of responses: it is training in a direction of what ’good’ looks like. Here the creator position comes through in the design of the fine-tuning; in the actions of the annotators, the structuring of the work, the Kenyans on a dollar an hour to rate which response they prefer ( Perrigo, 2023 ; Jefferson and Velasco, 2026 ; Arzberger et al., 2025 ) . Annotator positionality affects the model outcomes ( Coyne, 2026 ; Munir et al., 2026 ) , and is studied through lenses such as reflexive annotation ( Arzberger et al., 2026 ) and demographic analysis ( Kunilovskaya et al., 2026 ; González Barman et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 语言模型并非纯粹基于大规模无结构的学习而进入世界。 正在形成一种模式,以采取某些反应方式。 这往往通过培训与模范快速反应对联、微调和从人类反馈(RLHF)中强化学习(Chaudhari等人,2025年;Coyne,2026年)相结合。 这里有一个明确的步骤,就是对反应的规范解释:这是朝着`好'的外观方向进行培训。 在此,创作者的位置通过微调的设计;在注释者的行动中,作品的结构,肯尼亚人以每小时一美元来评定他们喜欢的反应(Perrigo,2023年;Jefferson and Velasco,2026年;Arzberger等人,2025年)。 注释者位置影响模型结果(Coyne,2026;Munir等人,2026),通过反射性注释(Arzberger等人,2026)和人口分析(Kunilovskaya等人,2026;González Barman等人,2025)等透镜研究.

blocks.en: Intended behaviour comes through increasingly in the form of a specification – perhaps a model card ( Mitchell et al., 2019 ) , but often something more lofty such as Claude’s Constitution ( Anthropic, 2026 ; Abiri, 2026 ) , or Open AI’s collective alignment ( OpenAI, 2025a ) . Guardrails and other structures are commonly used as frames for the stance that models should take ( González Barman et al., 2025 ; Widder and Nafus, 2023 ) – of course reflecting the positionality of the system designers. However, the enacted behaviour may well differ - models commonly fail to follow their constitutions ( Jakkli et al., 2026 ) . What happens in practice needs to be read from the interaction – the computational hermeneutics argument ( Kommers et al., 2026 ) . It may be read as ideology ( Cremaschi et al., 2025 ) , divergent behaviour in value tradeoffs ( Zhang et al., 2025 ; Ali et al., 2025 ) , different enactment of personality traits such as ’evil’ or ’sycophancy ( Chen et al., 2025a ) .
blocks.zh: 意向行为越来越以规格的形式出现 — — 也许是一种模范卡片(Mitchell et al., 2019),但往往有些更崇高的东西,比如克劳德的宪法(Anthropic, 2026; Abiri, 2026),或者开放AI的集体配对(OpenAI, 2025a). González Barman等人(González Barman等人,2025年;Widder和Nafus,2023年) — — 当然反映了系统设计者的地位。 然而,颁布的行为可能大不相同 -- -- 模式通常没有遵循其宪法(Jakkli等人,2026年)。 在实践中发生的事情需要从相互作用中读取 — — 计算性草药辩证(Kommers等人,2026年). 它可以被解读为意识形态(Cremaschi等人,2025年),价值权衡的不同行为(张等人,2025年;阿里等人,2025年),人格特征的不同制定,如‘邪恶'或‘共性'(陈等人,2025年a).

blocks.en: 3.4. System Prompts
blocks.zh: 3.4. 系统提示

blocks.en: System prompts are the place in the model stack that look most like commitments to and statements of positionality. The creator factors are broadly in line with standard product development, again with respect to constitutions ( Anthropic, 2026 ) , perhaps with political bias as a target ( Anthropic, 2025 ) . Despite their strong role in intended behaviour, whether due to commercial sensitivity or to prevent attacks, "system prompts are generally not made public and most platforms instruct models to conceal them" ( Neumann et al., 2026 ) . However, system prompts have been reverse engineered from running systems ( guy915, 2026 ) ; they are laden with positionality markers alongside interactional instructions, including identity, values, safety protection and communication style ( Neumann et al., 2026 ) . The enacted behaviour is not always in line with the intentions: models display biases that result in "differences in user representation" ( Neumann et al., 2025 ) . At the same time, the positional statements do not always carry through to behaviour ( Zheng et al., 2024 ) , and models do not always follow their constitutions ( Jakkli et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 系统提示(System points)是模型堆栈中最像是对位置的承诺和声明的地方. 创造因素与标准产品开发基本一致(Anthropic,2026年), 尽管在意向行为中发挥强大作用,无论是出于商业敏感性还是为了防止攻击,"系统提示一般不公开,大多数平台指示模型隐藏它们"(Neumann等人,2026年). 然而,系统提示已经从运行的系统(gen915,2026)中逆向设计出来;它们与交互指示,包括身份、价值、安全防护和通信风格,一起充满了位置标记(Neumann等人,2026年)。 颁布的行为并不总是与意图一致:模型表现出偏见,导致"用户代表的偏差"(Neumann等人,2025年). 同时,立场声明并不总是贯穿于行为(郑等人,2024年),模型也并不总是遵循他们的宪法(Jakkli等人,2026年).

blocks.en: 3.5. Application, presentation and interfacing
blocks.zh: 3.5. 应用、列报和接口

blocks.en: Without pretending to completeness, when constructing an LLM based system there are matters of i) connecting the model to other systems, whether realtime information, tools to carry out tasks, structured databases or something user configurable ( Lewis et al., 2020 ; Schick et al., 2023 ; Yao et al., 2022 ) ; ii) particular, application specific frameworks and workflows such as synthetic personas ( Schmidt et al., 2024 ; Yang et al., 2026 ) , analysis of legal documents ( Magesh et al., 2024 ) ; iii) a graphical or API interface for user interaction. Here again, the creator position is in line with system development – various vendors, development teams, engineers and so on – but potentially more diverse, as multiple applications are built on top of single language model systems, for example building legal analysis on top of ChatGPT ( Loizos, 2025 ) . They may follow design guidelines ( Amershi et al., 2019 , e.g.) , or be bound by legal requirements such as the transparency obligations of the EU AI Act ( European Union, 2024 , Article 50) . The intended behaviour here still draws on the layers below, but adds in presentational cues designed for the agent to be ’read’ in a certain way ( Karimova, 2026 ; Khadpe et al., 2020a ) ; questions of personalisation, and their attendant issues of bias ( Wagner and Cetinić, 2026 ) ; the metaphors used in description ( Blythe et al., 2025 ; Murray-Rust et al., 2022 ) ; or the use of AI disclosure methods to maintain user understanding that they are not speaking with a human ( Gausen et al., 2026 ) . The enacted behaviour is framed by the presentation, and interface framings of confidence change user reliance independent of accuracy ( Zhou et al., 2024 ; Kim et al., 2024 ; Steyvers et al., 2025 ) , and the contextual framing explains ~90% of variance in political-compass answers ( Bućan et al., 2026 ) . This comes through in the single confident speaker; the chat frame; the use of "I"; the presentation of curated selections "as if they were objective responses" ( Ghosh et al., 2026 ) , whether or not retrieval responses are fair ( Dai et al., 2023 ; Kim and Diaz, 2024 ) ; the praise/prompt envelope ( Grosser and Pold, 2025 ) . The careful construction of the presentation of a model as part of an application is part of the magic of system design, with the attendant risk that it enchants away serious issues under the surface ( Lupetti and Murray-Rust, 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: 在不装作完整的情况下,在构建基于LLM的系统时,需要将模型与其他系统连接起来,无论是实时信息、执行任务的工具、结构化的数据库还是用户可配置的东西(Lewis等人,2020年;Schick等人,2023年;Yao等人,2022年);二)特定的应用具体框架和工作流程,如合成人(Smidt等人,2024年;Yang等人,2026年);法律文件分析(Magesh等人,2024年);三)用户互动的图形或API界面。 在这里,创造者的位置再次符合系统开发 — — 各种供应商,开发团队,工程师等 — — 但可能更加多样化,因为多个应用程序都建立在单一语言模型系统之上,比如在ChatGPT之上建立法律分析(Loizos, 2025). 它们可能遵循设计准则(Amershi等人,2019年,例如),或受法律要求的约束,如欧盟AI法的透明度义务(欧盟,2024年,第50条). 这里的预期行为仍然借鉴了下面的几层,但在演示提示中添加了设计以某种方式 " 读取 " 代理人的提示(Karimova, 2026年;Khadpe等人, 2020年a),个性化问题及其伴随的偏见问题(Wagner和Cetinić, 2026年),描述中使用的比喻(Blythe等人,2025年;Murray-Rust等人, 2022年),或者使用AI披露方法来保持用户对他们没有与人类交谈的理解(Gausen等人, 2026年). 制定的行为由表述框架和信任变化用户依赖的界面框架而不受准确性的影响(周等人,2024年;金等人,2024年;史泰弗斯等人,2025年),背景框架解释了政治共通答案中差异的~90%(Bućan等人,2026年). 这在单一自信的演讲者中通过;聊天框;使用"I";介绍整理过的选题"仿佛是客观的回答"(Ghosh等人,2026年),是否检索回复是公平的(Dai等人,2023年;Kim和Diaz,2024年);赞美/即时信封(Grosser and Pold,2025年). 仔细构建模型作为应用的一部分呈现,是系统设计魔法的一部分,随之而来的风险是,它魔法了表面下的严重问题(Lupetti and Murray-Rust, 2024).

blocks.en: 3.6. Interaction

Beyond individual positionality, there are many factors of the user that influence the positionality played out in the interaction. Their purpose, skill and literacy will shape what they are able to co-create with the model ( Zamfirescu-Pereira et al., 2023 ; Long and Magerko, 2020 ; Lindley and Whitham, 2025a ; Lindley and Whitham, 2025b ) , as will their individual and shared history. AI-use disclosures in scholarship, and institutional guidelines on AI use will shape the approaches that users bring to their interaction with models. In terms of intended behaviours, there are the planned for applications of knowledge discovery, artificial companions, therapeutic tools, legal assistance and myriad others that form the default interactional frame. Users can also work with creative possibilities such as simulated humans ( Schmidt et al., 2024 ) for research purposes or co-speculation as a way to explore alternative ways of being ( Giaccardi et al., 2026 ) . Intentional stances can be taken towards model behaviour, for instance steering the political alignment ( Bućan et al., 2026 ) , and ’jailbreaking’ the model to rupture the positioning of previous layers ( Lee, 2023 ; Shen et al., 2024 ; Wei et al., 2023 ) . While user statements here are less common, and mostly fall under AI disclosure, some practices are shared as a statement of intent, such as jailbreak collections ( Shen et al., 2024 ) and techniques to improve role-persistence ( Chen et al., 2025b ) .
blocks.zh: 除了个人位置性外,还有许多用户因素影响相互作用中所表现的位置性. 他们的目的、技能和识字将塑造他们能够与模型共同创造的东西(Zamfirescu-Pereira等人,2023年;Long和Magerko,2020年;Lindley和Whitham,2025年a;Lindley和Whitham,2025年b),他们的个人和共同历史也是如此。 奖学金中的AI-使用披露,以及关于AI使用的机构准则,将决定用户与模型互动的方式。 就预期行为而言,计划应用知识发现、人工伴侣、治疗工具、法律援助以及构成默认互动框架的众多其他行为。 用户还可以利用模拟人类(Smidt等人,2024年)等创造性的可能性来工作,用于研究目的或共同推测,作为探索替代存在方式的方法(Giaccardi等人,2026年). 对模式行为可以采取有意的态度,例如引导政治调整(Bucan等人,2026年),以及打破模式以打破前几层的定位(Lee,2023年;Shen等人,2024年;Wei等人,2023年)。 虽然这里的用户声明不太常见,且大多属于AI披露范围,但一些做法作为意向声明共享,如越狱收集(Shen等人,2024年)以及改进角色持久性的技术(Chen等人,2025年b).

blocks.en: 3.7. Gaps and Inheritances
blocks.zh: 3.7. 差距和继承

blocks.en: Reading through this laminar stack, we see that statements of intended behaviour exist at every stratum, from the corpus to the system, although they tend towards statements of neutrality ; statements about creators tend to exist where they are in weaker positions – the annotators, the users – while vendors can sit behind abstracted claims of virtue and corporate value. The statements of enacted behaviour tend to be made by third parties, through audits or investigation. Especially as we reach the higher layers of the stack, we largely miss statement from deployers about the overall positionality of the systems that they put out, that deal with the cumulative effects of previous layers.
blocks.zh: 透过这个拉米纳堆,我们看到,从本体到系统的每一层都有关于意图行为的声明,尽管它们倾向于中立性的声明;关于创造者的声明往往存在于地位较弱的地方 — — 注释者、使用者 — — 而销售商可以坐到抽象的美德和公司价值的主张后面。 颁布行为的声明往往由第三方通过审计或调查作出。 特别是当我们到达堆积层的更高层时,我们基本上错过了部署人员关于他们所推出的系统的整体位置性的陈述,这些系统处理之前层层的累积效应.

blocks.en: We referred to these layers as a ’stack’ - a useful abstraction in programming, that gives a clean separation between layers, a decomposition of a project into sequential layers of a conceptual hierarchy. Perhaps, though, a better model here is inheritance , to borrow from Stengers ( Stengers, 2011 ) via Stürmer and Bella ( Stürmer and Bella, 2023 ) . In an inheritance framing, each stratum inherits material from the one before: whether a gift or a burden, the implications are carried and must be reckoned with. This reckoning can be seen in the responses of layers to the one prior: fine-tuning models towards respectful language rather than everything found on the internet; using guardrails to constrain the moral surface of model outputs relative to an open corpus. Inheritance also flows along temporal grounds: a corpus is fixed prior to a training run; a model is tuned relative to a slower, heavier baseline; system prompts and interfaces can change rapidly, even dynamically. In the presentations and statements in Table 1 , this is often what could be termed an act of anti-inheritance : hoping to smooth over or deny the foundations on which each layer is built. This anti-inheritance also often fails, by accident or design, in two broad ways: rupture and collapse .
blocks.zh: 我们把这些层称为 ' stack ' -- -- 一种有用的编程抽象,它能使层层之间保持干净的分离,将一个项目分解成概念层次的顺序层。 透过Stürmer和Bella(Stürmer和Bella, 2023年), 在遗产结构中,每个阶层从以前的阶层继承物质:无论是赠与还是负担,其影响都是要承担的,必须加以考虑。 从对前一种模式的分层反应中可以看出这种估计:对模型进行微调,使之以尊重语言而非互联网上的一切事物为目的;使用护栏来限制模型输出相对于公开体的道德表面。 继承也随时间因素而流动:在训练前确定一个实体;与较慢、较重的基线相比,一个模型被调整;系统提示和接口可以迅速变化,甚至是动态变化。 在表1的介绍和陈述中,这常常可以称为反继承行为:希望平息或否定每一层的基础。 这种反继承也常常以两种广泛的方式失败:破裂和崩溃。

blocks.en: Layers rupture and allow through the less structured material below. Chunks of text appeared directly in early model outputs, and despite significant effort, can still be provoked ( To and Le, 2025 ) , rupturing the smoothing claim that the models do not reproduce their training data, that there is a clear separation and reckoning with the inherited copyright material. The political shapes of training data emerge in the ideology of models ( Cremaschi et al., 2025 ) , rupturing claims of neutrality, or even a-positionality . Satire is reported as fact ( Germain, 2026 ) , rupturing the good behaviour of textual corpora as collections of fact. When model persona persists underneath a requested persona ( Yang et al., 2026 ) , the inheritance is too strong for the interaction stratum’s control and re-asserts its form. Rupturing can be a creative act: jailbreaking ( Shen et al., 2024 ; Lee, 2023 ) aims to reach the unreconstructed, raw responsiveness beneath the curated behaviours – using the lever of positionality, to appropriate the as-if nature of LLM performance and expose the hidden workings. Collapses happen when the readings possible at a certain layer become disjoint – when the form no longer gives information about the content, the scope of visibility and attention is unclear, the gap between stated and enacted positionality becomes not just wide but chaotic. In a collapse, the question of what it means to mean something shifts and the structures of knowledge de-laminate ( Murray-Rust and Giaccardi, 2026 ) . In the stack, we see this when the attributed qualities and the enacted behaviour diverge: when sycophancy takes over from truth ( Vishwarupe et al., 2026 ; Sharma et al., 2023 ) , when values are played despite not being held positionally ( Yun et al., 2026 ; Huang et al., 2025 ) , the emission of bullshit ( Hicks et al., 2024 ; Gershon, 2023 ) , when simple assistance becomes a latent persuasion towards an imagined centre ( Jakesch et al., 2023 ) .
blocks.zh: 层断裂,允许通过下面结构不严的材料。 在早期的模型输出中直接出现了文本的块块,尽管付出了很大努力,但仍然可以激怒(To and Le, 2025),打破了平滑的主张,即模型不复制他们的训练数据,对继承的版权材料有明确的区分和考虑. 训练数据的政治形态出现在模型的意识形态中(Cremaschi等人,2025年),令人发指地声称中立,甚至定位。 Satire被报道为事实(Germain, 2026), 当模型人a 坚持在要求的人a 下(Yang等人,2026年), 继承过于强大, 无法控制互动层, 捣毁可能是一种创造性的行为:越狱(Shen 等人,2024年;Lee,2023年)旨在利用定位的杠杆,达到未重建的原始反应能力,以适应LLM的性能,揭露隐藏的工作。 当某一层中可能的读数变得脱节 — — 当形式不再给出内容信息,能见度和注意力范围不明确,声明和颁布位置之间的差距不仅变得广泛而且混乱时,就会发生折叠. 在崩溃中,意味着什么的问题,即什么是变化和知识的去污结构(Murray-Rust and Giaccardi, 2026). 在堆叠中,当赋予的品质和规定的行为有差异时,我们就会看到这一点:当Sycophancy从真理中取而代之(Vishwarupe等人,2026年;Sharma等人,2023年),当价值虽然没有被定位(Yun等人,2026年;Huang等人,2025年),当简单的援助成为对想象中的中心的潜在说服(Jakesch等人,2023年)。

blocks.en: 4. Discussion
blocks.zh: 4. 讨论情况

blocks.en: After making the case that positionality is a relevant concept for LLMs, that it can be read across a stack, and has issues of inheritance, rupture and collapse, we now explore what positionality for LLMs means in context, and the implications of this argument.
blocks.zh: 在证明定位是LLMs的一个相关概念,可以跨一叠阅读,并有继承、破裂和崩溃等问题之后,我们现在探讨LLMs在上下文中意味着什么位置,以及这一论点的影响。

blocks.en: 4.1. Model positionality in context
blocks.zh: 4.1. 上下文中的示范位置

blocks.en: We opened with a question about where models ’speak’ from, between the implicit position of the vendors that they speak from nowhere , as synoptic abstractions, contrasted with Neuman’s position that they may speak from everywhere as they approximate most of human culture. Through unpacking the strata above, we develop the position that they speak from somewhere . Even if one were to agree with the idea that the world of text is all of human sociality, as models are built, this "everywhere" is sampled from a particular corpus, filtered by a particular rater pool, shaped by a particular vendor’s spec and a particular deployer’s prompt: it is a somewhere that has forgotten its address, and tries to avoid its inheritance. Just as contextual integrity ( Nissenbaum, 2011 ) helped to understand what goes wrong when speech moves between contexts, collapse of positionality helps to understand what happens when the context speech comes from cannot be read.
blocks.zh: 与Neuman的立场形成对比, Neuman认为他们可以从任何地方说话, 因为他们接近大多数人类文化。 通过解开上面的层层,我们形成了他们从某个地方说话的立场。 即使人们同意文本世界是人类所有社会性的概念,随着模型的建立,这个“任何地方”都从某个特定实体中抽取出来,由某个特定销售商的规格和某个特定部署商的迅速反应而过滤出来:这是一个忘记其地址并试图避免其继承的地方。 正如上下文完整性(Nissenbaum, 2011)有助于理解在语境间移动时发生什么错误, 定位的崩溃有助于理解上下文语境无法读取时会发生什么。

blocks.en: This is not necessarily an easy proposition: developing a model and conception of positionality at different layers needs to engage with plural approaches in a shifting technological milieu. However, some of the value lies in this difficulty: where a model claiming neutrality presents a "common world as already built", reflecting on where it speaks from is a practice of creating "space for hesitation regarding what it means to say ‘good’” ( Stengers, 2005 ) . The tracing of layers, unpacking the "shoggoth with a smiley face" ( Goujon and Ricci, 2024 ) is a way to deal with the inheritances of these systems ( Stürmer and Bella, 2023 ) : where the vendors neutrality disavows the inheritance of corpora and training and smooths it away behind a smiley face, and the view from everywhere reproduces it as the already realised cosmos, owning a position is a way to reckon with the debt, and bear witness to the processes along the way.
blocks.zh: 这并不一定是一个容易的命题:在不同层次上发展一种模式和定位概念,需要在不断变化的技术环境中采用多元方法。 然而,一些价值在于这一困难:一个声称中立的模型呈现出一个"已经建立的共同世界",反思它从何而来的做法就是创造"对什么是‘好'表示犹豫的空间". (Stengers, 2005) (英语). 追踪层层,解开"含笑脸的沙鼠"(Goujon and Ricci, 2024)是处理这些系统遗产的一种方法(Stürmer and Bella, 2023) : 销售商中立地否定了蝎子的继承权和训练,使其在含笑脸的背后平滑下来,各地的观点都将其复制为已经实现的宇宙,拥有一个位置是计算债务的方法,并见证了沿途的过程.

blocks.en: There are counter arguments to this framing. Firstly there is the ethical question of whether we have taken a concept built by and for marginalised knowers and applied it to corporate machinery. We hope that the effect is to use it as a diagnostic tool, except rather than critiquing the credibility deficit for Black women ( Hill Collins, 2000 , p. 252-256) we critique the credibility excess that comes from an implied "neutral" viewpoint. Just as positionality statements are used to contextualise researcher’s credibility in context, we hope to better understand the interactional credibility that language models obtain. There is also the question of whether it makes sense to apply positionality to something that is not human, and not an accountable speaker ( Gómez, 2026 ) . Here, we argue for separating the idea that positionality is a useful way to understand the relational characteristics of interaction from a deep ontological commitment to the idea that models are speakers – an eco-relationist viewpoint ( Safdari, 2025 ; Puzio, 2024 ) . This fits also with the computational hermeneutics model of understanding how to evaluate cultural technologies ( Kommers et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 对这一框架有反证。 首先,道德问题是,我们是否采用了一种由边缘知识者建立的概念,并将其应用于公司机制。 我们希望效果是用它作为诊断工具, 而不是贬低黑人妇女的可信度不足(Hill Collins, 2000, p.252-256), 正如立场性声明用来根据背景来分析研究人员的可信度一样,我们希望更好地了解语言模型获得的互动可信度。 还有这样一个问题:将立场适用于非人性而不是负责任的演讲者是否合理(Gómez,2026年)。 在这里,我们主张将立场性是理解互动关系特征的有益方式与对模型是演说者的深刻本体学承诺(一种生态关系论观点(Safdari, 2025;Puzio, 2024))分开。 这也符合理解如何评价文化技术的计算修辞模型(Kommers等人,2026年)。

blocks.en: 4.2. Implications

Framing through positionality highlights the difficulty of meaningfully talking about the operation of these composite technologies. While people at each layer can state their own positionality, take certain accountabilities, and account for factors of construction, it is a challenge to bring through the legacies of previous strata, or account for the gap between the intended behaviours and what is enacted in practice. The composite must be read ; there is value in looking at the making ; and there is a shift in accountability :
blocks.zh: 通过定位来分解突出地说明难以有意义地谈论这些复合技术的运作。 虽然每一层的人可以说明自己的地位,承担某些责任,并考虑到建筑因素,但通过过去阶层的遗留问题,或说明预期行为与实际实施行为之间的差距,是一项挑战。 综合内容必须读取,

blocks.en: Reading. Understanding models behaviour can move from "is this biased?" to "where is this spoken from?". This flows in line with practices that make position perceptible, whether direct readings ( Cremaschi et al., 2025 ) or creative processes such as discursion ( Cremaschi and De Angeli, 2026 ) , speculation ( Nicenboim et al., 2023 ) , glitch and hauntology ( Patil et al., 2024 ; Heron et al., 2026 ) , queering ( Turtle et al., 2026 ; Taylor et al., 2025 ) etc. Layered positionality can be a way to push back against phenomena such as weaponized empathy when models perform as-if they take particular values and standpoints ( Yun et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 读书. 理解模型的行为可以从"这有偏见吗?"转移到"这话是从哪里说的?". 这符合能够使人察觉到位置的做法,无论是直接读物(Cremaschi等人,2025年),还是异化(Cremaschi和De Angeli,2026年),投机(Nicenboim等人,2023年),滑稽和纠缠(Patil等人,2024年;Heron等人,2026年),同性恋等创造性过程。 (Turtle等人,2026年;Taylor等人,2025年)等. 分层定位可以是一种方法,在模型采取特定价值和观点时,对武器化同情等现象进行推后(Yun等人,2026年)。

blocks.en: Making. Much creative practice of making around AI works with the process of developing a position within generative systems ( Elwes, 2019 ; Hemment et al., 2022 ; Arzberger et al., 2024 ) , sculpting the latent space as part of a craft-based approach ( Lindley and Whitham, 2025a ; Lindley and Whitham, 2025b ) . This position-taking is connected to ideas that "artists remain the authors not only of their artworks but of the systems that shape them", that convivial , small models with more precise positioning are culturally valuable ( Sola and Guljajeva, 2025 ; Bendor et al., 2026 ) . Making positionality a first class object also supports extended practices such as co-speculation ( Giaccardi et al., 2026 ) , and co-performances ( Kuijer and Giaccardi, 2018 ) where "a game can be played" with negotiated rules to reflect back on ones own position and identity ( Turtle et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 做饭 围绕人工智能创作的许多创造性做法与在基因系中形成一个位置的过程(Elwes, 2019年;Hemment等人, 2022年;Arzberger等人, 2024年)合作, 将潜在的空间雕刻成基于工艺的方法的一部分(Lindley和Whitham, 2025a;Lindley和Whitham, 2025b)。 这种定位与“艺术家不仅是艺术作品的作者, 将定位作为头等物体也支持扩展的做法,如共同投机(Giaccardi等人,2026年),以及共同表演(Kuijer和Giaccardi,2018年),其中"可以玩游戏",通过谈判规则来反省自己的地位和身份(Turtle等人,2026年).

blocks.en: Accountability : Working with positionality affects the way that accountability can be constructed - owning the position is a different proposition to pretending to be neutral . Where much alignment is practiced as aggregation , a more positional approach preserves disagreement ( Ali et al., 2025 ) . This is the cosmpolitical move, to maintain equality of positions, rather than use their equivalence to average them ( Stengers, 2005 ) . In this mould, algorithmic pluralism brings in the question of which pluralities are present ( Jain et al., 2024 ) – effectively a call for a wider set of positionalities. This is part of addressing the "answerability-void argumentation" ( Zhang, 2026 ) of speech without an accountable entity behind it. If aggregation is sycophantic consensus , and accountability lives in acknowledging the limits of one’s perspective, surfacing value-conflict rather than smoothing it over ( Vishwarupe et al., 2026 ) , taking a position, grappling with the inheritances of the stack rather than a neutral presumption ( Fisher et al., 2025 ; Jakesch et al., 2023 ) .
blocks.zh: 问责制: 与定位合作会影响问责制的构建方式----拥有该位置是假装中立的另一种提议。 如果将许多调整做法作为汇总做法,则更注重立场的做法会保留分歧(Ali等人,2025年)。 这是共同政治的举动,目的是保持职位平等,而不是利用同等地位来达到平均水平(Stengers,2005年)。 在这个模版中,算法多元主义带来了哪一种复数存在的问题(Jain等人,2024年),这实际上是要求建立一套更广泛的立场。 这是解决言论的"可回答性-无效论证"(张,2026年)的一部分,没有背后的问责实体. 如果聚合是象征性的共识,而责任在于承认自己视角的局限性,那么就会产生价值冲突而不是平息(Vishwarupe等人,2026年),采取立场,处理堆积物的继承问题,而不是中性的推定(Fisher等人,2025年;Jakesch等人,2023年)。

blocks.en: 5. Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5.五. 结论

blocks.en: Through this paper we have built the case that i) not only is bias a partial description of the issues with language models, it encodes the idea of an unbiased , neutral position, that does not truly exist; ii) positionality is an alternate framing that can capture a broader set of issues; and iii) that positionality is a reasonable concept to apply to language models, as they are often treated as-if they are speaking, and that speech should come from somewhere . We then showed positionality factors across a laminar stack of model components and stages, looking at what was promised versus what is enacted, and discussed the inheritances from one layer to the next, and the ruptures and collapses that come from trying to avoid these inheritances.
blocks.zh: 通过这份文件,我们建立了这样一个案例,即:一) 不仅偏见是用语言模式对问题的局部描述,它把一个不带偏见的中立立场的概念编码起来,而这种立场并不是真的存在;二) 地位是另一个框架,可以捕捉更广泛的一系列问题;三) 立场是一个合理的概念,适用于语言模式,因为语言模式往往被当做是语言模式,而语言应该来自某个地方。 然后,我们通过一叠模型组件和阶段显示了位置因素,审视了所承诺的与所颁布的内容,并讨论了从一个层次到另一个层次的继承,以及试图避免这些继承所产生的破裂和崩溃。

blocks.en: Based on this, we advocate moving towards a positionality framed analysis of language models, in line with the framings of feminist epistemologies and computational hermeneutics. Positionality is an explicitation of what matters in a particular context, rather than a divergence from a presumed norm. This makes it a crucial component in understanding the performative and relational nature of interactions with language models, and we hope it may have better cognitive ergonomics for mental models of LLMs. Positionality is influenced by topics that are sensitive to biases – gender, race, class – but it covers more than that, and underpins values, ideology, stance and other issues that arise in dialogue rather than decision making. Our approach to discussing LLM positionality is a critical, diagnostic approach, to trouble the credibility excess constructed when these systems are believed beyond there warrant, as a position can be contested while a view from nowhere cannot.
blocks.zh: 基于这一点,我们主张按照女权主义认识学和计算修饰学的框架,向定位分析语言模型的方向发展。 立场性是在特定情况下表明什么才是重要的,而不是与推定规范的区别。 这使得它成为了解与语言模型互动的性能性和关系性的关键组成部分,我们希望它可能对LLMs的心理模型有更好的认知性ergonomics. 立场性受到那些对偏见敏感的话题的影响 — — 性别、种族、阶级 — — 但是它涵盖的不止于此,它支撑着对话而不是决策中出现的价值观、意识形态、立场和其他问题。 我们讨论LLM定位的方法是一个关键的、诊断性的方法,在认为这些系统超出其范围时,会给所构建的可信度过剩带来麻烦,因为一个立场可能会受到质疑,而一个观点从哪里也不可能。
